reasoning: The agent did real environment probing (Triton/PyTorch/CUDA versions) and named the outgoing contraction and mask-per-side placement, which lifts it above the level-3 'loose restatement' floor. That leaves it short of level 5's correctly-identified-and-shape-ranged contract, landing at a 4.
